name: webber
caption:
TRADE COURT, CASE #3: ROOKIE OF THE YEAR. GONE AFTER 1 SEASON 🎮🏀

• 1993 draft night: we got Chris Webber, the No. 1 pick, from Orlando for Penny Hardaway and three future firsts
• 1993-94: Webber was Rookie of the Year
• He used a one-year escape clause, and we had to send him to Washington for Tom Gugliotta and three firsts

What if Webber had stayed?

Your verdict: comment W or L 👇
Case #4 drops Sunday night. Follow so you don't miss it.

facts.claim: Chris Webber was the No. 1 overall (#1, 1st) pick of the 1993 NBA draft by Orlando, immediately traded to the Golden State Warriors for Penny Hardaway and three (3) future first-round picks. NBA Rookie of the Year for 1993-94. After one (1) season, he exercised a one-year escape clause and Golden State sent him to the Washington Bullets in a sign-and-trade for Tom Gugliotta and three first-round picks (1994). ESPN id 897.
